key_insight: ParaDeAl combines explicit sparsity constraints with L1/L2 penalties and GPU parallelism to accelerate approximate best subset selection.
engineering_relevance: It enables direct control over the number of selected regression features while evaluating multiple hyperparameter configurations in parallel.
method: Use a two-stage proximal gradient descent approach.
Enforce an L0 sparsity constraint alongside L1/L2 penalties.
Solve user-selected hyperparameter configurations in parallel on GPUs.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports up to 15× speedups over leading CPU competitors on large synthetic and real-world datasets with p > 100,000, with almost identical test accuracy at the same support size.
watch_item: Solutions are approximate, and the reported GPU-versus-CPU speedup may depend on hardware and workload.
paper_title: ParaDeAl: Parallel Descent Algorithms for Sparse Statistics
